capabilities: Edit properties through dropdowns limited to allowed values
Show fields belonging to a note type as one-click placeholders
Flag values, fields, or fields that break user-defined rules
Color values and group tag menus, including folder-backed and link-search fields
Define, export and import property rules as JSON
extras: Warns that editing rewrites the whole property block, removing YAML comments and possibly changing quoting and list style. Desktop only. Properties used by other plugins (cssclasses, aliases, banner, kanban-plugin) are never flagged or changed. Manifest notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's property panel lets you type any field and any value. This plugin puts your own rules on top of it
problem: Obsidian's property panel accepts any field name and any value, so there is no way to restrict or validate them against your own rules.

relations.evidence: A skill is included for AI coding agents such as Claude Code.

summary: Rule-based property editor that replaces free-text property input with dropdowns, type-aware fields, colored values and validation flags.
